text:
Which statement about magnetism is correct?
A
An unmagnetised iron bar becomes magnetised when it is placed near a magnet.
B
An unmagnetised steel bar can be magnetised by passing a current through it.
C
The direction of magnetic field lines is from an S-pole to an N-pole.
D
The N-poles of two magnets attract each other.

options.label: A
options.text: An unmagnetised iron bar becomes magnetised when it is placed near a magnet.

options.label: B
options.text: An unmagnetised steel bar can be magnetised by passing a current through it.

options.label: C
options.text: The direction of magnetic field lines is from an S-pole to an N-pole.

options.label: D
options.text: The N-poles of two magnets attract each other.
